decision_tree.aggregate: 8/8 PASS => R6 PASS; any FAIL => R6 FAIL; otherwise any UNRESOLVED => R6 UNRESOLVED
decision_tree.coverage: COV-A; do not drop D1 or alter 4/4 direction coverage
decision_tree.per_series: PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED per direction and response using the six registered gate items

P1_generation.gradient_stencil: central difference in interior; first-order one-sided at each box face
P1_generation.normalization: divide by maximum absolute raw value, cast little-endian Float32, retain max=1

direction_inventory.coverage: COV-A: all four directions and both responses must pass; 8/8 required

formal_preregistration_template.pass: finite/integrity; nonzero same sign; both magnitudes >= k_mag*sigma0; abs error <= max(3*sigma_pred,tol_hold*abs(S_pred))
formal_preregistration_template.prediction_model: calibration full six-point Model A only; no formal refit
formal_preregistration_template.state_order_rule: baseline plus 4 directions x 3 formal epsilon x plus/minus

geometry_reject_gates.canonical_shape_dtype_order: point_shape, little-endian float32; raw file serialized Fortran order

ladder.jitter: J1; none; exact repeats are not a noise estimate
ladder.nominal_coefficient_semantics: epsilon_m multiplies the max=1 phi direction; do not replace with effective physical displacement
ladder.rule: numpy.geomspace(0.5,5,6), float64 values serialized with 17 significant digits

measurement.aggregate_solver_time_definition: sum of registered per-state Julia wall_seconds excluding each state's first compile/warmup step, consistent with the bound W4 job
measurement.qualification_claim: frozen Candidate C/v17/flow_24 local diagnostic only

not_claimed: field gradient, reverse, optimizer, topology, or shape-update qualification

numeric_contract.C1_C2_C3: diagnostics only; never reclassify historical Stage 1 results
numeric_contract.C4: semantic comparison against exact binary64 inputs evaluated by the high-precision Decimal reference
numeric_contract.C5: conditional fit/operand backward-error engineering envelope, not a universal LAPACK/SVD theorem
numeric_contract.covariance: inverse(X.T @ W @ X), nominal conditional plug-in; no chi-square/dof rescale; no sandwich
numeric_contract.dimensionless_diagnostics: relative SE, nested shift, and model difference formed from internal N/mm values
numeric_contract.estimator: OLS pilot on exactly each selected point set; construct pilot variance; one WLS pass

retry_policy.post_registration_source_fix_required: do not amend old criteria; preserve attempt and create a new preregistration from a new source identity
retry_policy.post_registration_transient_external_inf: retry same immutable criteria and source, save every attempt
retry_policy.pre_registration_source_harness_input_er: repair, rerun applicable checks, integrate clean source, then create new criteria
